title: Pandas GroupBy, Apply & Sorting Simulator
description: Trace the Split-Apply-Combine lifecycle, custom function execution with .apply(), derived compensation calculation, and multi-key descending sorting.

steps.title: Instantiate Organizational Records
steps.explanation: Pandas creates a 6-row by 3-column DataFrame. Rows belong to 3 distinct categorical departments: IT (rows 0, 2), HR (rows 1, 3), and Sales (rows 4, 5).

steps.title: Split Phase: Partitioning by Department
steps.explanation: Pandas inspects the 'Department' key and forms internal index buckets: HR -> [1, 3], IT -> [0, 2], Sales -> [4, 5]. No math has run yet (lazy evaluation).

steps.title: Apply & Combine Phase: Compute Mean Salary
steps.explanation: Pandas evaluates .mean() across each partition independently: HR=(45k+48k)/2=46.5k, IT=(50k+60k)/2=55.0k, Sales=(52k+58k)/2=55.0k, and stitches them into a clean Series.

steps.title: Multi-Metric Aggregation with .agg()
steps.explanation: .agg() computes multiple summary statistics in a single pass, outputting a DataFrame with columns ['mean', 'count', 'max'] indexed by Department.

steps.title: Custom Transformation: .apply() with Lambda
steps.explanation: The lambda expression (s * 0.10) evaluates for each salary scalar in the column, generating a new Bonus series: [5000, 4500, 6000, 4800, 5200, 5800].

steps.title: Vectorized Feature Synthesis: TotalPay
steps.explanation: Element-wise vector addition combines base salary and bonus, forming the total compensation column: [55k, 49.5k, 66k, 52.8k, 57.2k, 63.8k].

steps.title: Descending Sort: sort_values()
steps.explanation: Rows are reordered from highest compensation to lowest: Rahul (66k) -> Divya (63.8k) -> Kiran (57.2k) -> Arun (55k) -> Meena (52.8k) -> Priya (49.5k).

steps.title: Global Summary Verification
steps.explanation: Extracts rank-1 leader (Rahul with 66,000.0) and computes total enterprise payroll disbursement (344,300.0).
